biological_boundary_disclaimer: CRITICAL SCIENTIFIC BOUNDARY: Aspen Plus V14 provides rigorous thermodynamic and transport calculations for vapor-liquid equilibria, steam latent heats, and convective air psychrometrics. However, legume biological cell-wall hydration, pectin esterase de-esterification, calcium ion cross-linking, and cellular starch gelatinization kinetics are outside Aspen's thermodynamic framework. These biological phenomena are governed by empirical multiphase reaction-diffusion equations and remain subject to Gate G-A Hold pending physical wet-lab validation.
